name: 霓虹遊樂場
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE full square 1024x1024 collectible puzzle illustration, not collage. Reference character Joy must remain recognizable: round peach chibi face, fluffy curled brown hair in little side bunches, huge warm dark eyes, bright playful expression and pastel pink yellow mint signature palette. Entirely NEW modern arcade streetwear: pink varsity jacket, mint pleated skirt, yellow sneakers, little star hairclip, headphones around neck. Joy excitedly playing a retro arcade cabinet in a cozy pastel neon game arcade. Premium soft 3D clay/plush miniatures, high detail consistent reference. Full body with hands clearly on controls. Surrounding edge-to-edge environment: pinball machine and neon shapes left, plush prize crane right, tiled floor and scattered game tokens below, pendant lamps and retro pixel-shaped decorative lights above. Neon lilac peach aqua glow but clear readable forms in every quadrant. Absolutely no text numbers letters logos watermark borders puzzle lines or split panels.
